name: agent-activity
title: Agent Activity
description: Collapsed agent work in a transcript: a quiet cue that opens the extra-details sheet with that beat’s thinking and tool calls, a named-task card for a delegated run, and a standalone thought or live Exploring line. Hosts pass a RandomAvatar on exploring cues and named cards — busy while that agent is working, still once it is not. By default the cue opens the host’s Sheet (open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange are gone): put AgentActivityContent in the sheet body. A host with no sheet sets opens="inline" on the trigger and renders AgentActivityContent below it while it is expanded.
